verdict.rationale: Mastra documents processors that 'transform, validate, or control messages as they pass through an agent', which matches the story's validate/transform/block framing. It also ships a built-in PromptInjectionDetector that scans user messages for injection and jailbreak patterns, so input-side guardrails are explicitly covered. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of output-side guardrails (e.g. PII or moderation on responses), documentation of how blocking or aborting works, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
